findings.summary: send_pkt stores skb into long-lived chan->data (line 447) and builds iv.iov_base = skb->data (line 449); caller bt_xmit() runs dev_kfree_skb(skb) at line 549, leaving a dangling stored pointer with no in-tree reader for IPSP channels in s04.

candidates.reason: dma from skb->data only stored on the path where the skb is retained in fp->rx_skbuff[i]; unwind loop pairs dev_kfree_skb with rx_dma[i]=0.
len is a scalar read before netif_rx(skb); no pointer into skb data is used after the handoff in s04.
echo skb length/extension fields are read before dev_consume_skb_any; can_get_echo_skb uses skb_get() before netif_rx.
